segments.text: Day one of 100 Days of Machine Learning: what is machine learning, really?
segments.caption: Day 1 of 100 Days of Machine Learning: what is machine learning, really?

segments.text: Rules versus learning, how a machine actually learns, and the three types. Save this one!
segments.caption: Rules vs learning, how a machine actually learns, and the 3 types. Save this one!

segments.text: You've already used machine learning a dozen times today.
segments.caption: You've already used machine learning a dozen times today.

segments.text: Your phone unlocked when it saw your face. Gmail hid a spam email. YouTube picked your next video. Google Maps guessed the traffic.
segments.caption: Your phone unlocked when it saw your face. Gmail hid a spam email. YouTube picked your next video. Google Maps guessed the traffic.

segments.text: Nobody wrote rules for any of that. These systems learned.
segments.caption: Nobody wrote rules for any of that. These systems learned.

segments.text: Here's how computers normally work. A programmer writes the rules.
segments.caption: Here's how computers normally work. A programmer writes the rules.

segments.text: Say we want to catch spam. We write a rule: if an email says free money, it's spam.
segments.caption: Say we want to catch spam. We write a rule: if an email says free money, it's spam.

segments.text: Data and rules go in. Answers come out.
segments.caption: Data and rules go in. Answers come out.

segments.text: But spammers just write free money with a three and a zero, and our rule breaks. We'd need millions of rules.
segments.caption: But spammers just write "fr3e m0ney", and our rule breaks. We'd need millions of rules.

segments.text: Machine learning flips this around.
segments.caption: Machine learning flips this around.

segments.text: We give the computer thousands of emails, each one already labelled: spam, or not spam.
segments.caption: We give the computer thousands of emails, each one already labelled: spam, or not spam.

segments.text: And it works out the rules by itself.
segments.caption: And it works out the rules by itself.

segments.text: Data and answers go in. The rules come out.
segments.caption: Data and answers go in. The rules come out.

segments.text: Here's the textbook definition.
segments.caption: Here's the textbook definition.

segments.text: Machine learning is a branch of artificial intelligence where computers learn patterns from data, instead of being explicitly programmed.
segments.caption: Machine learning is a branch of artificial intelligence where computers learn patterns from data, instead of being explicitly programmed.

segments.text: Or, as Arthur Samuel put it in nineteen fifty-nine: giving computers the ability to learn without being explicitly programmed.
segments.caption: Or, as Arthur Samuel put it in 1959: giving computers the ability to learn without being explicitly programmed.

segments.text: So how does a machine actually learn? Let's watch it happen.
segments.caption: So how does a machine actually learn? Let's watch it happen.

segments.text: Here are some houses: their size, and their price.
segments.caption: Here are some houses: their size, and their price.

segments.text: The machine starts with a random guess. This line. It's terrible.
segments.caption: The machine starts with a random guess. This line. It's terrible.

segments.text: So it measures how wrong it is. That's the error.
segments.caption: So it measures how wrong it is. That's the error.

segments.text: Then it nudges the line, to be a little less wrong. And again. And again.
segments.caption: Then it nudges the line, to be a little less wrong. And again. And again.

segments.text: After many rounds, the error is tiny. Guess, measure the error, adjust, repeat. That's learning.
segments.caption: After many rounds, the error is tiny. Guess, measure the error, adjust, repeat. That's learning.

segments.text: What it ends up with is called a model: a learned recipe that turns inputs into predictions.
segments.caption: What it ends up with is called a model: a learned recipe that turns inputs into predictions.

segments.text: Give it a house it has never seen, say fifteen hundred square feet, and it predicts the price.
segments.caption: Give it a house it has never seen, say 1,500 square feet, and it predicts the price.

segments.text: The inputs are called features. The answer it predicts is called the label.
segments.caption: The inputs are called features. The answer it predicts is called the label.

segments.text: Machine learning comes in three main types.
segments.caption: Machine learning comes in 3 main types.

segments.text: Supervised learning: learning from examples with answers, like spam or not spam.
segments.caption: Supervised learning: learning from examples with answers, like spam or not spam.

segments.text: Unsupervised learning: no answers at all, just finding hidden groups, like types of customers.
segments.caption: Unsupervised learning: no answers at all, just finding hidden groups, like types of customers.

segments.text: Reinforcement learning: learning by trial and error, with rewards, like a computer mastering a video game.
segments.caption: Reinforcement learning: learning by trial and error, with rewards, like a computer mastering a video game.

segments.text: So where does it all fit? Artificial intelligence is the big circle: machines doing smart things.
segments.caption: So where does it all fit? Artificial intelligence is the big circle: machines doing smart things.

segments.text: Machine learning sits inside it. And deep learning, the tech behind Chat G P T, sits inside machine learning.
segments.caption: Machine learning sits inside it. And deep learning, the tech behind ChatGPT, sits inside machine learning.

segments.text: So remember: in normal programming, we write the rules. In machine learning, the machine learns the rules from data.
segments.caption: So remember: in normal programming, we write the rules. In machine learning, the machine learns the rules from data.
